title: 第一卷 第1314章 捣毁血月教万座据点第一卷 第1313章 帝族姜家
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：九天轮回诀第一卷第1314章捣毁血月教万座据点！
（..la）“帝族姜家……太虚大帝？”
叶无尘若有所思，当年他与四大帝族都是竞争关系，但和姜家的几位老祖关系还算不错，曾青梅煮酒，坐而论道。
“好了，现在出现了就赶紧上台来吧。”
望着底下的秦风，白斩擦拭着手中的长剑，声音颇为冷彻。
姜燕鸣这话可谓是极高的评价了，因为元妍妍的琴艺是众所周知的厉害。
看见房门被打开后，众人本能的向后退了退，但是看到进来的却是两个陌生男子，众人脸上一脸疑惑。
下一个步骤，贴花钿。
花钿一般都是贴在脑门上，起个装饰作用。
原来正是当时跟随在明帝画舫左右的那条渔船，渔船上仍是那个白衣白绫头戴箬笠人。
但溟师的羽剑大阵却困不住图瓦，只见图瓦竟跳了出来，又要放箭。
从怀中拿出之前秦风给他的传讯令牌，轻轻一丢，便把令牌丢到了炸弹阵中心。
但不知为何的是，周云梦虽然在这次的行动中收获颇丰，而她的眉宇间却始终有一抹忧虑神色。
“怎么会呢！
我这辈子最幸福的事儿就是遇见你了，我怎么可能会瞧不起你呢？”
刘保田真情实切的说道。
三弟张飞虽然压着华雄打，但是想要拿下华雄，短时间也不可能。
怎么想都猜不出来对方是如何做到，凭借识脉境的修为来对抗问鼎境。
因为伍樊了解尧屠一伙的打算，占了先机，几个组合拳一打，就让尧屠上当。
老头依然手背与身后，抬头看天。
好像一位正在担心雨水浇坏花花草草老人。
面对浩劫，绝大多数的仙门选择了封山闭关，而有的仙门之中，却有强者飘然升空，向万妖谷赶去。
“这怎么处理？”
唐尘踩了踩自己脚下的帕楚里亚，同时身上斗气猛然绽放，直接撞飞了周围围拢过来的怪物！
他们两个还没有进入戴尔那层护盾中，怪物们自然是可以靠近的——但其实唐尘他们比那层护盾难对付多了吧？
艾伦的命令让狄克感到恐慌，居然连丧钟的特点都知道。
而且也有了针对的方法。
不能让他再下命令了，狄克向着艾伦方向冲去。
“不对！”
艾伦终于发现有些问题了。
低声的喊了一声。
声音又把再场的人吓得一顿。
所有人又趴得更低了。
“早没事了，过两天就能上山打虎，下海擒龙了。”
木成和笑嘻嘻道。
林豹正苦命的开着自己的车，看着这重复的场景，昏昏欲睡。

(..la) "The Jiang family of the imperial clan...Emperor Taixu?"
Ye Wuchen thought thoughtfully. Back then, he had a competitive relationship with the four imperial clans, but he had a pretty good relationship with several ancestors of the Jiang family. Zeng Qingmei cooked wine and sat down to talk.
"Okay, now that you've shown up, hurry up and get on stage."
Looking at Qin Feng below, Bai Zhan wiped the sword in his hand with a rather cold voice.
Jiang Yanming's words can be described as extremely high praise, because Yuan Yanyan's piano skills are well known to everyone.
After seeing the door being opened, everyone instinctively stepped back, but when they saw two strange men coming in, everyone looked confused.
The next step is to apply the decals.
Mother-of-pearl flowers are usually attached to the forehead for decoration.
It turned out that it was the fishing boat that was following Emperor Ming's boat at that time. On the fishing boat, there was still the man in white clothes and white silk silk with a bamboo hat on his head.
However, Master Ming's feather sword array could not trap Tuva. Tuva actually jumped out and was about to release another arrow.
He took out the summons token that Qin Feng had given him before from his arms, threw it lightly, and then threw the token into the center of the bomb array.
But for some reason, although Zhou Yunmeng gained a lot from this operation, there was always a look of worry between her eyebrows.
"How could it be!
The happiest thing in my life is meeting you. How could I look down on you? "
Liu Baotian said sincerely.
Although the third brother Zhang Fei suppressed Hua Xiong and fought, it was impossible to capture Hua Xiong in a short time.
No matter how hard you think about it, you can't guess how the other party did it, relying on the cultivation of the Consciousness Pulse Realm to fight against the Aspiration Realm.
Because Wu Fan understood the plans of Yao Tu and his gang, he took the advantage and with a few combined punches, Yao Tu was fooled.
The old man still held his hands behind his back, looking up at the sky.
It seems like an old man is worried about the rain damaging his flowers and plants.
Facing the catastrophe, the vast majority of immortal sects chose to close the mountains and retreat, but among some immortal sects, there were strong men floating into the sky and rushing towards the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons.
"How to deal with this?"
Tang Chen stepped on Pachulia under his feet, and at the same time his fighting spirit suddenly bloomed, knocking away the surrounding monsters!
The two of them haven't entered Dell's shield yet, so the monsters can naturally get close - but Tang Chen and the others are actually much more difficult to deal with than that shield, right?
Alan's order made Dick panic, and he actually knew the characteristics of Death Knell.
And there are also targeted methods.
Unable to let him give any more orders, Dick rushed towards Allen.
"No!"
Allen finally discovered something was wrong.
He shouted softly.
The sound frightened everyone present again.
Everyone lay down lower again.
"It's all over now. In two days I can go up to the mountains to hunt tigers and go to the sea to catch dragons."
Muchenghe said with a smile.
Lin Bao was driving his car hard, looking at this repeated scene and feeling drowsy.
